fieldNotes.location: Roster address '11400 Stratton Dr' and coordinates were wrong (geocode APPROXIMATE, 9396 m off). Web research found the real address: 1205 Chavenelle Court, Dubuque IA 52002, in the Dubuque Industrial Center West. Locked center 42.4879,-90.7661 — a 348,000 sq ft Hormel-owned production plant (Compleats meals, chunk chicken, bacon toppings, SPAM), opened 2010.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint at the plant entrance; no perimeter fence around the property. The plant is set back behind a landscaped lawn off the public industrial-park road (Chavenelle Court). Open access driveway with a wide truck apron. Classified false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any controlled entrance — fully open site.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long landscaped approach plus a very wide internal truck apron easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide unused paved apron south of the dock face leaves ample room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 25-50 band — clear dock face along the south building wall with ~20+ trailers backed in plus additional dock positions. Overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 25-50 band — multiple rows of parked trailers in the SW drop yard (gravel/paved), ~30-40 trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated SW trailer-storage lot, partly unpaved, separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant sits in an industrial park on the edge of Dubuque with farmland immediately to the south; borderline call, scored Rural per the 'when torn, choose Rural' guidance. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
